answer: Five hands, ten castings, twenty stamps — one twenty-minute tide. Forty terrace gates open at the inlet each epoch. A pearl cast into the inlet sinks past a gate's mark; its fall is seeded by the last block and the key, so no pearl can repeat. Each claim locks 70 POA, +40 per extra identity from one root: ten linked fakes lock 2,500 POA. Each gate needs two stranger stamps; no stranger or operator covers more than two gates. An unmanned gate burns 20 POA; a pearl cast at two gates burns both bonds. Casting times are matched to funding roots: one operator's ten gates collapse into one.
